This script takes your gameplay to the next level by removing the M1 cooldown, allowing you to unleash a relentless barrage of attacks without pause. Perfect for crowd control, strategic positioning, or just showcasing your flair, the flinging system integrates seamlessly into the gameplay, offering both utility and style.
